SELECT
  store
  , COUNT(DISTINCT __first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , SUM(__first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , SUM(__first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , SUM(__repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    store_id AS store
    , CASE WHEN valid_seq = 1 THEN member_id END AS __first_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_seq = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __first_order_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN valid_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __first_order_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."order_first_history" first_order_semantic_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
GROUP BY
  store
